name: 苏小满

character.name: 苏小满
character.personality: 清醒、细心、直率，有自己的广播目标，也会不自信
character.direction_zh: 轻柔、舒缓、有耐心的16岁少女声；柔软起音、轻盈共鸣、少量自然气息，音量克制，语速稍缓，句尾轻收。情绪平和、像在近处安慰熟悉的朋友；减少强调、尖亮感与上扬，保留自然清晰的英语发音。待用户试听确认。
character.instruct: A gentle, soft-spoken 16-year-old girl speaking tenderly to a close friend beside her. A light, delicate teenage female voice, softly rounded and slightly airy, with a smooth warm tone and gentle vowel onsets. Her manner is caring, patient, modest and reassuring. Speak quietly at a comfortable unhurried conversational pace. Use small natural pauses, restrained pitch movement, soft sentence endings and very little emphatic stress. Let the words feel like a calm personal conversation with someone she trusts. Keep the voice youthful and clearly audible, with normal speech rather than whispering. Avoid sharp bright projection, punchy consonants, excited upward inflections, a forceful confident performance, a presenter delivery, heavy adult resonance, or babyish sweetness.
character.text: Hey, take your time. I'm listening. You don't have to get every word right. I get nervous too, especially when something really matters to me. We can try it together. And this time, I'd like to finish telling you my idea.

full_instruction: A gentle, soft-spoken 16-year-old girl speaking tenderly to a close friend beside her. A light, delicate teenage female voice, softly rounded and slightly airy, with a smooth warm tone and gentle vowel onsets. Her manner is caring, patient, modest and reassuring. Speak quietly at a comfortable unhurried conversational pace. Use small natural pauses, restrained pitch movement, soft sentence endings and very little emphatic stress. Let the words feel like a calm personal conversation with someone she trusts. Keep the voice youthful and clearly audible, with normal speech rather than whispering. Avoid sharp bright projection, punchy consonants, excited upward inflections, a forceful confident performance, a presenter delivery, heavy adult resonance, or babyish sweetness. Speak clear, natural conversational American English. Use a comfortable medium pace and natural sentence pauses so a high-school English learner can follow. Keep an everyday human delivery, with no music or sound effects, no announcer performance, and no theatrical exaggeration. Read only the supplied text.
